codeReview.summary: The commit adds a substantial pull pipeline and broad test coverage, but two contract-critical behaviors are not implemented at this revision: functional inline benchmarking for --bench and a live download progress indicator.

issues.description: `--bench` is implemented as a placeholder: after ensure_dependency("vllm-mlx"), it only prints that benchmark support will arrive later instead of running a quick benchmark and reporting prompt_tps/gen_tps. This misses VAL-CROSS-014 and the feature expectedBehavior for `pull --bench`.

Download execution uses subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True), which suppresses HuggingFace CLI progress output. The user only sees static start/complete messages, so live progress indication required by VAL-PULL-005 is not met.
The VAL-PULL-005 test checks only generic text (`Pulling` or model name), so it cannot detect absence of real progress updates.
The VAL-CROSS-014 test only verifies `_run_post_download_bench` is invoked and does not assert benchmark metrics output, dependency auto-install outcome, or temporary runtime cleanup behavior.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `cli-feature` skill instructs command registration in `src/mlx_stack/cli/__init__.py`, but this repo's established pattern is command registration in `src/mlx_stack/cli/main.py`.
